related.title: 工業矽量子點：交叉列控制線的擴充代價
related.titleEn: Industrial silicon quantum dots: crossbar wiring tradeoffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：同時通過人口與相位檢查才談可用量子搬運，並檢查往返是否抵消部分靜態相位。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Require population and phase checks for usable quantum transport; test whether return paths cancel static phase. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 量化理想行列共用線的線數節省，同時辨識共用控制的限制。
related.differenceEn: Quantify ideal row/column wiring savings while identifying shared-control limits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每次搬運翻轉率p=0.001，總搬運N=100；僅計算未出現任何翻轉的機率。 P無翻轉=0.999^100。 代入 0.999**100，得到 0.904792 dimensionless。獨立等機率錯誤下P保留=(1−p)^N；相關錯誤或相干誤差不符合此乘法。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。比較16×16陣列的逐點與理想行列線數。 線數比=N²/(2N)。 代入 16**2/(2*16)，得到 8 ratio。N×N陣列逐點一線需N²條，理想行列共用需2N條，節省比N/2；不含屏蔽、讀出、局部修調與冗餘。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-transfer flip probabilityp=0.001 andN=100 transfers; calculate the probability of no flip, not final parity. Pno-flip=0.999^100. Substituting 0.999**100 gives 0.904792 dimensionless. For equal independent error probabilityPsurvival=(1−p)^N; correlated or coherent errors violate this product. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Compare individual and ideal crossbar wiring for a16×16 array. Wiring ratio=N²/(2N). Substituting 16**2/(2*16) gives 8 ratio. AnN×N array needsN² individual lines versus2N ideal crossbar lines, a ratioN/2; shielding, readout, trim and redundancy are excluded. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
